common_flow: Open the site and search for the user query.
On results, identify job cards and traverse visible unvisited cards top-to-bottom.
On detail, prefer the detailed job description tab or section when visible.
Collect visible text from the main detail and any embedded detailed description area shown on screen.
Return to the results list and continue with the next unvisited card.

collection_policy.finish_condition: Requested trend sample size is reached or no unvisited cards remain.

known_pitfalls: Detailed requirement text can be visually separated from the main metadata area.
The DOM adapter handles iframe text, but the vision runner must rely on what is actually visible after scrolling.
